identityDecision: Use the named Værne Kloster farmyard and manor core as the physical anchor for the former royal estate, Knights Hospitaller monastery and hospital, and later manor and active farm.

historicalScope.source: Store norske leksikon; Lokalhistoriewiki; Moss byleksikon
historicalScope.finding: Værne developed from a royal estate into Norway's only Knights Hospitaller monastery and hospital and later a large manor and working farm. Some monastery remains survive, while the estate and protected agricultural landscape extend far beyond the yard.

yearDecision.reason: Store norske leksikon places the foundation in the 1190s, while local-history sources preserve wider uncertainty. The numeric year is not treated as exact.

crossChecks.finding: Links OSM way 124839227 and Kulturminne ID 9570; entity coordinate lies approximately 109.4 metres west of the applied farmyard point.
Both identify the current site at Klosterveien 91, 1570 Dilling; Lokalhistoriewiki gives gnr. 189/bnr. 1.
The protected landscape covers approximately 5,473 decares and must not be inferred from the gameplay circle.

rejectedCandidates.reason: Remote point southeast of the named site without a source-object identity.
Valid farm-locality cross-check, but the named farmyard polygon gives the stronger physical core.
Access infrastructure approximately 250 metres southwest of the historical core.
One archaeological fragment would reduce a combined monastery, hospital, manor and estate record to one component.
A 5,473-decare legal and ecological landscape extent is not a point-coordinate substitute.
The estate changed over time and no invented historical centroid or boundary is applied.

accessDecision.rule: The coordinate identifies the site but does not imply public access to the farmyard, buildings or monastery remains. Tasks must use lawful public viewpoints and roads.

radiusDecision.covers: The manor house, named farmyard and immediate monastery-core environment for gameplay.
